title: Configuring an audio spectrogram
description: You can read how the plot represents audio frequency content.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: A spectrogram displays frequency content across audio segments. You pass audio, the sample rate SR and the supplied FFT size to specgram.
You label the horizontal and vertical axes and add a power colorbar. The magma color map supplies the visual encoding.

steps.question: Does the vertical limit display every frequency produced by the calculation?
steps.answer: It displays only the supplied range starting at zero on the frequency axis.

steps.description: show requests the configured spectrogram. The supplied recording contains no text output or image from which to identify spectral peaks.
